extraction.normalization: Native standalone footprints translated to origin and rotated to zero. KiCad library export converts back-side footprints to front-side library coordinates by reversing local Y. Back-side selection remains inspect-only. Generated UUID records and SVG export timestamp removed. Original board unchanged.

scope: Original attributed board context. Circular front SMD copper pads can define isolated hypothetical joint requests. Board-level mask, actual package, wetting, and coupled assembly remain unresolved.
